contracts.routing: Commit/react to family, spin one subtype at declared weights, commit subtype source effects and react, resolve declared child wheels sequentially with a reaction per result, then restore saved caller.
contracts.profileAuthority: Profiles here are canonical. Inline race outcomes are mirrors/pointers and must not execute a second copy.

godAuthorityMaximum.status: User confirmed all God powers use shared base9 and skip Power Mastery spin.
godAuthorityMaximum.target: All actual owned powers of the committed God character, including Authority, Divine and ordinary future grants.
godAuthorityMaximum.timing: Check owned inventory/guarantee before RNG; fixed base then applicable bonuses/debuffs only at finalize. Final scores remain signed/unbounded.
godAuthorityMaximum.formula: Every God owned power final mastery =9 + distinct applicable shared modifiers.
godAuthorityMaximum.sharedBase: One fixed shared base9; no sampled result or mastery reaction.
godAuthorityMaximum.ordinaryPowers: Actual God subtype fixes the one shared Power Mastery base9 for all owned present/future powers, including Authority, Divine and ordinary grants.
godAuthorityMaximum.projectionGuard: Actual committed God source only; no activation by matching a name/definition.
godAuthorityMaximum.duplicatePolicy: Deduplicate the same source grant on replay. Authority-mode and ordinary concept-power grants remain distinct source instances; never merge them in a way that transfers the max override.
godAuthorityMaximum.limits: Fixed base9; final signed/unbounded. No intrinsic Tier/concept/domain or main-stat maxima are granted.

godPowerScarcity.status: User-confirmed normal Power result split: 80% None, 20% a power.
godPowerScarcity.activation: An actual committed God subtype source. Register source once; multiple references/replays do not multiply the 80% failure mass.
godPowerScarcity.target: Later normal Power acquisition wheel: main stage and authorized normal-pool bonus acquisitions whose guard permits None.
godPowerScarcity.excluded: God Concept, all Divine/themed event calls, fixed grants, direct title rewards and acquisitions explicitly guaranteed to exclude None are unaffected.

distribution.powerConditionalOdds: After all declared eligible-power guards and modifiers, normalize the remaining positive non-None weights within the 20% group.

godPowerScarcity.resolution: One actual normal Power spin with this final odds snapshot. No preliminary success/failure wheel or reroll. Main None never removes owned Authority/Divine/fixed powers.
godPowerScarcity.validation: For an applicable normal draw require an eligible configured None result and at least one eligible non-None positive weight. Unspecified base weights use 1; missing pools or invalid/zero-total eligible weights are configuration errors.
godPowerScarcity.idempotence: Freeze/commit actual odds and result once by invocation. Resume/replay does not draw again.

powerMasteryModifiers.status: User-confirmed +1 Power Mastery; applies to the one shared character rank for ordinary powers, while any actual God Authority uses base9 plus the same final shared modifiers.
powerMasteryModifiers.timing: Register the original authorized source modifier once when earned. Resolve raw mastery/Resilient at the ordinary scheduled stage; calculate this bonus only in final bonus phase from the retained immutable base, never at the earlier draw.
powerMasteryModifiers.emptyInventory: No phantom power/mastery draw. Finish normal acquisitions and use the one inventory gate.

numericStats.timing: Register once from actual subtype result and apply each after the immutable base stat using the signed, unbounded final-score policy.

utusan-tuhan.mastery: ordinary shared rank with its +1 shared modifier

contracts.ownedInventory: Retain actual power grants after main None. God uses fixed shared base9/no spin for every power; other subtypes use one ordinary shared resolution. No phantom power.
contracts.duplicatePowerResults: No distinct-result guarantee: God makes two independent Divine invocations; Angel two independent Angelic invocations, each using its canonical eligible pool. Preserve duplicate results/source ordinals, no reroll. General merge policy remains pending; Authority/ordinary concepts stay distinct.
contracts.classification: Subtype selection does not select the main family again. Utusan/Pemuka/Orang Saleh are user-defined spiritual role entries in this family; they dispatch no Human, Reinkarnasi Pahlawan Legendaris or religion selector. Demigod runs no Hybrid, God parent event or Awakening unless separately authorized.
contracts.inheritedOrigins: Authorized Skeleton/Zombie origin or Hybrid/host callers execute the same approved subtype profiles with source component, shared no-repeat race history and saved return.
contracts.size: All subtypes participate in the existing global Size stage. Source-backed body metric/profiles remain pending; divine identity grants no extra Size spin or unlisted main stat.
contracts.idempotence: Commit subtype/effects once per run/source component/sourceSpinId/profile. Child key includes followupStepId and childOrdinal, so Concept child 1 differs from Divine child 1/2. Replay/media retries duplicate no source bonus, override, grant, scarcity profile or spin.
contracts.weights: Preserve subtype weights 1:1:2:2:3:3. Proposed Concept outcomes use equal defaults; Divine and Angelic each twenty equal outcomes at 5%, four per tier. Concept roster remains proposed.

bonusTimingMigration.policy: This global timing policy supersedes earlier inline calculation timing for new invocations only. Amounts/scopes/odds/raw-draw stages and original source ownership remain unchanged.

maximumGuaranteeContract.scope: Actual committed maximum guarantees for stats or mastery skip the random wheel.
maximumGuaranteeContract.God: Actual God subtype fixes the one shared Power Mastery base9 for all owned present/future powers, including Authority, Divine and ordinary grants.
maximumGuaranteeContract.VesselGod: God patron at compatibility60/70/80/90/100 inherits the existing maximum guarantee; all owned Power Mastery base9. Lower bands and demon patron do not qualify.
maximumGuaranteeContract.Lich: Committed Lich fixes Durability base9; no singleton100% spin in new runs.
maximumGuaranteeContract.notGuarantees: High lore probability, intrinsic Tier5, matching power names and Kinnara minimumMaster are not maximum guarantees.
maximumGuaranteeContract.timing: Check owned inventory/guarantee before RNG; fixed base then applicable bonuses/debuffs only at finalize. Final scores remain signed/unbounded.
maximumGuaranteeContract.hooks: No random sample, actual attempt, spin ID, Lucky hit, Resilient retry, Double/Nothing decision or sampled Pawn category for automatic bases.
maximumGuaranteeContract.precedence: Explicit maximum before random shaping/Equalizer/Gambler. Contradictory hard exclusions require configuration. Empty power inventory creates no phantom mastery.
maximumGuaranteeContract.history: Existing frozen actual God/ordinary mastery and Lich singleton draws replay unchanged; no retroactive guarantee rewriting.
